title: THE FREQUENCY BENEATH · The bird's colors
venue: private · after a paperback found in the library's return cart · Box 26
logline: The bird drawn as a spectrum: its colors laid out in a band across the page in order, and under each color a wavelength drawn as a small wave of the right length, and the whole thing lined up over the flats' steady trace from the earlier page. Nothing lines up. The page is honest about that.

panels.composition: A horizontal band of the bird's colors across the page in spectral order, beneath each color a small drawn wave of proportionate length, and beneath those the steady flat trace from the flats page; the waves and the trace visibly failing to align, the bird itself small in the corner on a seawall.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a horizontal band of rainbow colors in spectral order across a page with a small drawn wave beneath each color and a flat steady trace beneath those visibly failing to align, a small rainbow bird on a seawall in the corner, no words legible
image.notes: The bird against the substrate. Nothing lines up; the page says so by drawing the misalignment.

art.line: the private line, but ruled: graph paper, waveforms, spectrogram bands drawn by hand
art.palette: ochre and slate; the trace in one warm color
